svg.title: Stack bootstrap and credential handoff
svg.desc: The administrator, telemetry publisher and Fleet chains have distinct identities and consumers. ESO owns secret materialization and publication; the provider owns generated token resources.
svg.text: Collectors do not receive admin auth
Fleet document needs observed Stack ID
ProviderConfig is created before the Secret exists; the readiness gate delays stack-local children.
Within a row, arrows show dependencies / references. Blue arrows carry credential publication or references, not token values.
